_: Region sheet for saxhleel-coast (2.5a1b). Talk is seeded from the region's published place records; every trait cites a lore dossier or says inferred.

entries.name: Archon and the eastern coast (the Saxhleel coast)

norms.text: Children play underwater games; being amphibious is ordinary here.
The harbour works in three dimensions: dive lots, wrecks and moorings.
A hiring camp shares what it forages among every family in it.
Place names are clauses, given without thought: a lot is named for what happened there.

values.text: A tally kept straight: pay and deaths both entered.
Paperwork as the line between a harbour and a pirate.

contempts.text: Mystics who talk grandly about the sea and cannot swim it.
Landlords who evict families to clear a jungle lot.

place.text: The coast is the harbour, the beach and the reef below it.

work.text: Diving, fishing and harbour labour; the deep lots pay best and kill most.

people.text: Sailors of every race come through Archon and most of them pay.

faction.text: The harbour authority charters the pirates it cannot beat.

hist.text: The coast tribes keep their trees quietly and mind the water first.

empire.text: The Company's wharves are standing; the Company is not.

trade.text: Archon is the province's legal port and proud of it.

danger.text: Reefs, sharks and the deep lots; a lair inland drives foragers off.

rumour.text: The Dark Brotherhood wants the Shadowscale house.

directions.text: Ways are given by water: so many strokes off the point, so many fathoms down.

addressTerms.text: Strangers are called by their boat or their errand; locals by the lot they dive.
Imperatives without ceremony: come here, go round.

neverSaid.text: What the old ku-vastei near the sealed house used to do.
The count of divers lost this season.

grievances.text: Evicted families live at the hiring camp a kilometre east of Bones-And-Tools.
The deep lots pay best, but they kill divers. The tally book records the pay and the deaths.

rumours.text: A lot with no living heir must be reassigned. The claimants will settle it in the water.
Glowgill guar have been seen breeding wild off the point.

views.text: Tear and Thorn are a short sail; Dunmer cargo pays well and argues long.
Lilmoth rebuilds and undercuts us on every run.
The deeps come down to the coast only to raid.
The heartland keeps the trees; the coast keeps the water.
River crews come down to the coast looking for work and trouble.
